_meta.notes: Comprehensive index for the Democratic Republic of the Congo covering Bantu migration, Kongo, Luba, and Lunda kingdoms, King Leopold's Congo Free State (rubber terror), Belgian Congo, Lumumba assassination, Mobutu/Zaire, Congo Wars (Africa's World War), Kabila era, and conflict minerals.

natural_resources.notes: World's largest cobalt producer (70% global supply, essential for lithium-ion batteries/EVs); 'geological scandal'—potentially $24T in untapped mineral wealth; coltan/cobalt child labour crisis (artisanal mining); Kasai diamonds; Katanga copper belt; Congo River hydropower potential (Inga 3/Grand Inga could power half of Africa)

military.nuclear_status: Non-nuclear (had Belgian-supplied nuclear reactor, Africa's first)
military.notes: FARDC chronically underfunded/poorly trained; M23 rebel resurgence (2022-present, Rwanda backing); MONUSCO peacekeeping withdrawing; armed groups ~120 in eastern DRC; Mai-Mai militias; ADF/ISIS affiliate in Beni; state of siege in North Kivu/Ituri

infrastructure.notes: Only 2% roads paved; Congo River waterways critical; Inga-Shaba power line.

natural_hazards: volcanic eruptions (Nyiragongo, fluid lava, destroyed half of Goma 2002)

debt_aid.notes: Among world's largest aid recipients; HIPC debt relief; Chinese infrastructure-for-minerals deal (Sicomines $6.2B); Mobutu embezzled ~$5B; relatively low debt ratio due to enormous GDP denominator from mining

education.notes: Colonial Belgians left only 30 university graduates at independence (1960); French-language instruction; conflict disrupted education in east; 'education tax' system shifts costs to parents; Catholic Church runs ~60% of schools

diaspora_migration.diaspora_population: 2.0 million (Angola, Republic of Congo, France, Belgium, South Africa, USA)
diaspora_migration.notes: Both major refugee host and producer; M23/ADF/ethnic conflicts produce ongoing displacement; 5.6M internally displaced (largest in Africa); Great Lakes refugee complex (Rwandan, Burundian, Congolese circular displacement)
diaspora_migration.immigration_policy: Open to SADC/COMESA but practically permeable borders

digital_economy.notes: Mobile money critical (most adults unbanked); Vodacom M-Pesa dominant; despite challenges, vibrant tech scene in Kinshasa; internet expensive; conflict minerals traceability tech growing; Radio Okapi (UN-backed) most trusted media

country_profile.notes_unique: Second-largest country in Africa; holds ~70% of the world's coltan reserves essential for electronics; the Congo River is the world's deepest river.

geography.terrain: Central basin is vast tropical lowland plateau; mountains in east (Rift Valley); plateaus and savanna in south; dense equatorial forest
geography.notes: 2nd largest country in Africa (11th globally); Congo River basin contains world's 2nd largest rainforest; Virunga volcanoes; 80% of world's coltan reserves.

economy_extended.notes: Mining superpower: 70% world cobalt, 80% coltan, copper, gold, diamonds, tin; '$24 trillion in untapped mineral reserves'; Gécamines and Tenke Fungurume; conflict minerals issue.

health.notes: Ebola outbreaks (2018-20, Kivu; 2022); mpox; severe doctor shortage; conflict zones lack health infrastructure entirely.

food_agriculture.notes: 26M food insecure (2024, world's largest food crisis); 80M hectares arable potential only 10% used; conflict disrupts agriculture especially in east.

energy.notes: 100GW+ hydro potential (largest in Africa); Grand Inga Dam project (44GW planned); Inga 1&2 dams operate below capacity; <20% electrification.

transport.notes: Vast country with minimal road network; Congo River system vital for internal transport; all DRC airlines historically EU-banned for safety.

tourism.notes: All 5 UNESCO sites listed as 'in danger'; Virunga gorilla tourism recovering; Nyiragongo lava lake; bonobos are DRC endemic.

human_rights_gender.notes: Extensive conflict-related sexual violence (especially eastern provinces); child soldiers; cobalt mine child labor; mass displacement.

security_stability.notes: World's largest IDP crisis; MONUSCO (UN mission, withdrawing); 120+ armed groups in east; M23 resurgence since 2022; mineral-fueled conflict.

cultural_heritage.film_industry: Growing (Nollywood influence; local production in Kinshasa)
intangible_heritage_items: Congolese rumba (UNESCO 2021, shared with Republic of Congo)
cultural_heritage.media_landscape: Vibrant but pressured; Radio Okapi (MONUSCO); many private stations
cultural_heritage.notes: Richest musical tradition in Africa; rumba/soukous global influence; 200+ ethnic groups; 4 national languages (Lingala, Swahili, Tshiluba, Kikongo).

legal_system.customary_law_role: Significant in land and family matters
legal_system.notes: ICC cases: Lubanga, Ntaganda, Katanga convicted; military courts handle many civilian cases in conflict zones; justice system barely functions in east.

comparative_rankings._note: Country position relative to continent and global.
comparative_rankings.notes: Paradox of immense mineral wealth and extreme poverty.
